title: Hamaara Pehla Imam
body:
Salam Ya Ali Salam Ya Ali
Khuda Ne Bheje Hain Jispar Durood Aur Salam
<<MINI>>
Shaheed Aaj Hua Hai Hamara Pehla Imam
Shaheed Aaj Hua Hai Hamara Pehla Imam
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Imam Aisa Jo Allah Ka Iraada Hai
Imam Aisa Jo Zaujay Janabe Zehra Hai
Imam Aisa Jo Pyaare Nabi Ka Saya Hai
Imam Aisa Jo Hasnain Ka Bhi Baba Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Uss Imam Ki Duniya Mai Aaj Akhri Shaam
2) Hussaini Maaon Ne Bachon Ko Apne Samjhaya
Ali Ke Qatl Ke Ye Din Hain Misle Ashoora
Libaas e Sog Pehen Kar Bichao Farshe Aza
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Din Vo Hain Ke Khushi Bhi Haram Hai Beta (2x)
Guzaaro Girya o Zaari Mai Apne Subho Shaam
3) Zamaana Laakh Mukhaalif Ho Ye Bataana Hai
Kisi Bhi Haal Mai Yom e Ali Manana Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aza Ke Lafz Ki Hurmat Ko Bhi Bachana Hai Ke Jaan Deke Bhi Farshe Aza Bichana Hai (2x) Phir Agle Saal Kahainge Ali Ke Saare Ghulaam
3) Ajeeb Gham Ka Ye Mah e Sayaam Aya Hai
Ali Ke Qatl Ka Samaan Saath Laaya Hai
Nabi Ko Qabr Mai Jisne Lahu Rulaya Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali Ke Bachon Ne Daaghe Yateemi Paya Hai (2x)
Ali Ke Shiyon Mai Barpa Hai Dard Se Kohraam
4) Namak Khujoor Se Iftaar Karne Wala Imam
Fida Rasool Pe Gharbaar Pe Karne Waala Imam
<<DIVIDER>>
Udu e Deen Pe Yalghaar Karne Wala Imam
Khuda Ke Bando Se Hi Pyaar Karne Wala Imam (2x)
5) Tamaam Karke Tahajjud Khuda Ka Shair Chala Phir Apne Ghar Se Chala Suye Masjid e Kufa
Jagaake Apne Hi Qaatil Ko Ye Ali Ne Kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Kaam Karne Ko Aya Hai Kyun Nahi Karta?
Ye Kehke Mola Mera, Namaz Parhne Laga, Hui Jo Pehli Rakat, Laeen Uqab Se Barha...
Chalayi Taigh e Jafa, Shigaaf Sar Ko Kiya, Namazi Ronay Lagay, Ali Ki Aayi Sada...
Fuzto Be Rabbil Kaaba, Fuzto Be Rabbil Kaaba
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Bujhi Thi Zeher Mai Talwaar Uss Sitamgar Ki
Shigaaf Karte Huay Sar Jabeen Tak Utri
Khabar Ye Khaana e Zehra Mai Jis Ghari Pohonchi
Hasan Hussain Se Zainab Tarap Ke Kehne Lagi (2x)
<<DIVIDER>>
Falak Se Aaya Hai Jibreel Ka Ye Kaisa Payaam
7) Jahan Ko Dete Hain Paighaam Mesum o Mazher
Nahi Qayamat e Sughra Se Kam Ye Gham Dilpar
Ali Ke Sog Mai Farshe Aza Bichay Ghar Ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Hameysha Bhejiye Lanat Bhi Ibne Muljim Par (2x)
Allahuma Laan Qatalata Ameerul Momineen
